methodology: Eight named variants measured after quick reload and6s; three selected-list bootstrap failures repeated in fresh profiles initialized with the same stored variant id. All11 actual role, glyph, primary and MiniApp observations on identical named source hashes. This is UI/color QA, not a performance benchmark.

analysisCorrections.reason: The existing audit overlayEvents array is page memory and resets on each actual page reload. Each theme row has an independent callback scope even when the browser profile is reused. No observations or product sources changed.

limitations: Headless installed Edge with synthetic MockClient and terminal native mocks; native WebView/GPU/DPI and live accounts not checked
Fixture scenario hash is restored before every reload because chat navigation replaces the startup scenario hash; loadChats/simulateConnected are replayed

Eight stored choices have quick cached reload plus6s coverage; three previously missing mock chat-list rows use fresh stored-profile bootstrap, then6s stability. These three do not independently verify cached restart. The user profile and Windows theme are untouched

Button is actual default primary component in existing callback-only overlay. Four bright black-foreground palettes also cover hover/focus/no-ripple-active; no-page-transitions body class is set only in isolated browser and immediately restored. Disabled states are outside this check

Contrast values are mathematical color observations with task-provided4.5/3 thresholds, not a claim of complete WCAG conformance. Own subtitle opacity is composited; native GPU and physical display appearance are unverified
SavedMessages raster sidebands cover CSS icon vertical bounds conservatively; anti-aliasing, user zoom and physical display calibration are outside measurement
Before role-change product contrast was not measured by this subagent; unsuccessful reload bootstrap attempts are excluded
